blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Nuclei instance segmentation is a core task in digital pathology, yet high-accuracy models rely on
large vision transformer (ViT) encoders whose inference speed cannot meet real-time clinical demands.
We propose a lightweight scheme that distills the UNI2-h pathology foundation model into a
ConvNeXt-Tiny student (Ours-T, 34.7M parameters, 1/20 of the teacher) via output-level knowledge
distillation. Ours-T achieves an mPQ of 0.519 on PanNuke (98.8% of the teacher), a zero-shot bPQ of
0.668 on MoNuSeg, and an inference speed of 634.3 img/s, requiring only 0.045 s for full-resolution 1024 2 1024^{2} analysis (21.8 × \times speedup). Experiments further show that multi-scale gated convolution
(MALA) yields no gain under ViT encoders, and output-level distillation alone suffices for efficient
knowledge transfer.
blocks.zh:
核实例分解是数字病理学的核心任务,但高精确度模型依赖于
大型视变器(ViT)编码器,其推论速度无法满足实时临床需求.
我们提出了一个轻量级计划,将UNI2-h病理基础模型提炼成一种
ConvNEXt-Tiny学生(我们的T,34.7M参数,教师的1/20)通过输出级知识
蒸馏。 我们-T在PanNuke上实现了0.519的mPQ(占教师的98.8%),0射的bPQ =
MoNuSeg上的0.668,推断速度为634.3 img/s,全分辨率1024 2 1024^{2}分析(21.8×\时速)只需要0.045 s. 实验进一步表明, 多重规模的大门进化
(MALA)在ViT编码器下不产生收益,仅输出级蒸馏就足以高效
知识转让。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Nuclei instance segmentation—jointly detecting, segmenting, and classifying each nucleus—is a key
prerequisite for downstream quantitative analyses such as tumor grading, immune-infiltration assessment,
and prognosis prediction. Nuclei in histopathology images are densely packed, morphologically diverse,
and exhibit large staining variation, imposing stringent demands on segmentation accuracy and robustness.
HoverNet [ 1 ] pioneered multi-task learning that jointly predicts nuclear pixels (NP),
horizontal-vertical distance maps (HV), and nuclear classification (NC), and has become the de facto
baseline; HoverUnet [ 2 ] further compressed HoverNet into a lightweight U-Net via
distillation. CellViT [ 3 ] introduced vision transformers (ViTs) to nuclei segmentation
with substantial gains, but its parameter count ballooned to ∼ \sim 700M. CFR-SAM [ 4 ] adapts
SAM [ 5 ] to nuclei segmentation and achieves state-of-the-art results on both PanNuke
and MoNuSeg, serving as the strongest baseline prior to this work.
blocks.zh:
核心实例分解——共同检测、分解和分类每个核心——是一个关键
下游定量分析的先决条件,如肿瘤分级、免疫渗透评估,
和预测。 组织病理学图像中的核素是密集的,形态多样的,
并表现出巨大的污点变化,对分解的准确性和强度提出了严格的要求。
HoverNet [1] 开创了联合预测核像素的多任务学习,
横向垂直距离图(HV)和核分类(NC),已经成为事实上的
基线; HoverUnet [2] 进一步压缩 HoverNet 进入轻量级 U-Net 通过
蒸馏。 CellViT [3] 引入视变器(ViTs)进行核分裂
它的参数已经升到 \\sim 700M。 CFR-SAM [4] 适应
SAM [5] 到核分裂, 并取得最新的结果 在PanNuke
MoNuSeg是这项工作之前最有力的基线。

blocks.en:
Meanwhile, pathology vision foundation models such as UNI [ 6 ] and Virchow [ 7 ] exhibit powerful general-purpose feature extraction through large-scale
pretraining, but their hundreds of millions of parameters (UNI2-h: 683.6M) incur slow inference and heavy
memory footprint, hindering direct deployment in real-time clinical analysis. How to retain the feature
capacity of foundation models while obtaining a lightweight, fast inference model is the core problem
addressed in this paper.
blocks.zh:
同时,UNI[6]和Virchow[7]等病理视觉基础模型通过大规模提取显示出强大的通用特征。
预先训练,但他们的数亿参数(UNI2-h:683.6M)的推论很慢而且很重
记忆足迹,阻碍在实时临床分析中直接部署. 如何保留特性
基础模型的能力,同时获得轻量级,快速推论模型是核心问题
本文件中述及的问题。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose output-level knowledge distillation from UNI2-h to ConvNeXt-Tiny, with the
following contributions: (1) a lightweight student Ours-T —34.7M parameters, retaining 98.8%
mPQ under 20 × \times compression, and only 0.045 s for 1024 2 1024^{2} inference; (2) a multi-task shared
decoder that reaches parity with only 37% of the parameters of independent decoders; (3) a
negative result —multi-scale gated convolution (MALA) brings no gain under ViT encoders; and (4) comprehensive validation on PanNuke (mPQ 0.519) and zero-shot MoNuSeg (bPQ 0.668, surpassing
CFR-SAM-H).
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提议从UNI2-h到ConvNEXt-Tiny的输出级知识提炼,
下列捐款: (1) 轻量级学生Ours-T-34.7M参数,保留98.8%
mPQ在20×x\times压缩下,只有0.045 s的1024 2 1024××2}推论; (2)一个多任务共享
仅达到37%的独立解码器参数的等值的解码器; (3) a
负结果——在ViT编码器下,多尺度的门化演化(MALA)不会带来任何收益;和(4)在PanNuke(mPQ 0.519)和零镜头 MoNuSeg(bPQ 0.668,超过)上进行全面验证
(原始内容存档于2017-10-10). CFR-SAM-H.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overall Architecture and Teacher Model
blocks.zh: 2.1 整体建筑和教师模式

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 shows the overall architecture, comprising an encoder, a shared U-Net decoder,
and task-specific heads. The teacher model (Ours-H) uses UNI2-h (ViT, 683.6M) as the encoder, producing
features at four scales (1/4 to 1/32) that are passed to a lightweight shared U-Net decoder (6.9M) via skip
connections. The three tasks (NP/HV/NC) share all decoder weights, following multi-task learning [ 14 ] , and each task head is a single 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution. The decoder adopts
learnable ConvTranspose upsampling and CBAM attention [ 10 ] (NC head only). We also verify an
independent-decoder variant (UNet3, 18.8M) whose mPQ is on par with the shared decoder, confirming the
parameter efficiency of the shared design; a multi-scale gated convolution module (MALA, 3 × 3 / 5 × 5 / 7 × 7 3\times 3/5\times 5/7\times 7 parallel convolutions with per-pixel gating) yields no significant gain (Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
图1显示了整体架构,包括一个编码器,一个共享的U-Net解码器,
和任务负责人。 教师模型(Ours-H)使用UNI2-h(ViT,683.6M)作为编码器,生产
通过跳过传递给轻量级共享的U-Net解码器(6.9M)的四种比例尺(1/4至1/32)的特性
连接。 三个任务(NP/HV/NC)共享所有的解码器权重,遵循多任务学习[14],每个任务头都是单1×1 1\times 1 controduction. 解码器采纳
可学习的 ConvTranspose Upsamping 和 CBAM 注意 [10] (仅NC头). 我们还核实
独立解码器变体(UNet3,18.8M),其mPQ与共享解码器相同,确认
共享设计的参数效率; 一个多尺度的门式演化模块(MALA, 3× 3 / 5× 5 / 7× 7 3\times 3/5\times 5/7\times 7与每像素的成形平行演化)不会产生显著收益(第3.4节).

blocks.en: 2.2 Lightweight Student Model and Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 轻量级学生模型和蒸馏

blocks.en:

Ours-H into a ConvNeXt-Tiny [ 8 ] student (encoder 27.9M + + shared decoder 6.9M, 34.7M in
total, ∼ \sim 20 × \times compression) via output-level distillation [ 9 ] . The
distillation loss combines Kullback-Leibler divergence and mean squared error:

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en:
PanNuke [ 11 ] contains ∼ \sim 7,900 256 2 256^{2} H&E images across 19 tissue types and five
nuclear classes (Neoplastic, Inflammatory, Connective, Dead, Epithelial), split by tissue-level 3-fold
cross-validation. MoNuSeg [ 12 ] is used to assess cross-organ zero-shot generalization.
We report the standard PanNuke metrics: mPQ ( = = DQ × \times SQ, the primary metric), bPQ, per-class F1, and
additionally AJI on MoNuSeg.
blocks.zh:
潘纽克 [11] 包含 ∼\sim 7,900 256 2,256^{2}19种组织类型的H&E图像和5种
核类(Neoplastic,炎症,连通性,死亡,Epitherial),由组织级3倍分裂.
交叉验证。 MoNuSeg [12] 用于评估跨组织零射一般化.
我们报告PanNuke标准衡量标准:mPQ(==DQ×\times SQ,主要衡量标准),bPQ,每级F1,以及
此外,莫努塞格的AJI。

blocks.en: 3.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 执行细节

blocks.en:
All models are implemented in PyTorch 2.11 / CUDA 12.8. UNI2-h uses official weights, and ConvNeXt uses
ImageNet-22K weights from timm. We use AdamW (lr 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} ); the
encoder is frozen for the first 100 epochs and then fully fine-tuned for 200 epochs under a cosine annealing
schedule. Augmentation includes flips, rotations, affine transforms, color jitter, Gaussian blur, and
elastic deformation. To counter severe class imbalance (Dead occupies only 0.06%), we adopt
inverse-frequency class-balanced sampling. The teacher is trained on an NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU with automatic
mixed precision; Ours-T requires only 4GB VRAM for inference.
blocks.zh:
所有模型在PyTorch 2.11 / CUDA 12.8中实施. UNI2-h 使用官方权重, ConvNEXt 使用
图像Net-22K 重量来自 Timm. 我们使用 AdamW (lr 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10 × 4 },重量衰减 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10 × 3 });
编码器在前100个纪元中被冻结,然后在余弦反射下对前200个纪元进行全面微调
时间表。 增强包括翻转、旋转、芳香变换、色焦、高斯模糊和
弹性变形. 为了消除严重的阶级不平衡(死亡只占0.06%),我们采用了
逆频类平衡采样. 教师接受NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU自动培训。
混合精度; Ours-T 只需要4GB VRAM即可推论.

blocks.en: 3.3 Comparison with State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 3.3 与艺术国家的比较

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of average bPQ and mPQ on PanNuke (bold = best).
blocks.zh: 表1:PanNuke上的平均bPQ和mPQ的比较(粗体=最佳).

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports the average comparison on PanNuke. Ours-H attains an mPQ of 0.524, 2.5% higher
than the previous best CFR-SAM-H (0.511); Ours-T retains an mPQ of 0.519 under 20 × \times compression, only
1.0% below the teacher, with merely 34.7M parameters (less than 1/19 of CFR-SAM-H), demonstrating the
parameter efficiency of a lightweight backbone combined with a shared decoder. In terms of bPQ, Ours-H and
Ours-T (0.681/0.683) remain slightly below CFR-SAM-H (0.696), because watershed post-processing separates
densely overlapping nuclei less robustly than the SAM prompt mechanism; nevertheless, the mPQ improvement
indicates that UNI2-h features, together with the CBAM and ConvTranspose upsampling of the shared decoder,
compensate for the instance-separation gap in class discrimination.

blocks.en: 3.4 Ablation and Distillation Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 沉淀和沉淀分析

blocks.en: Table 4: Decoder-design ablation.
blocks.zh: 表4: 编码器-设计衰竭.

blocks.en:
The decoder-design ablation (Table 4 ) shows that the shared decoder (6.9M) attains the same
performance with only 37% of the parameters of independent decoders, confirming the implicit regularization
of multi-task sharing; adding MALA ( + + 3.8M) yields no gain. In distillation experiments, the KD student
retains 98.8% of the teacher’s mPQ (vs. 97.9% for training from scratch), and the + + 0.006 gain is
meaningful under 20 × \times compression. Adding MALA to the student decoder decreases mPQ from 0.5187 to
0.5150, and encoder feature alignment (MSE, λ = 0.1 \lambda{=}0.1 ) also brings no improvement (mPQ 0.5150),
indicating that output-level distillation already suffices for heterogeneous ViT → \to CNN architectures and
feature alignment is unnecessary.

blocks.en: 3.5 Inference Speed
blocks.zh: 3.5 推断速度

blocks.en:
On an NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU, considering pure inference (without post-processing): Ours-H (690.5M, 186.7
GMacs/tile) reaches 24.8 img/s in a single batch; Ours-T (34.7M, 11.6 GMacs) reaches 105.8 img/s at
bs = = 1 and 634.3 img/s at bs = = 32, a 24.2 × \times speedup. For full-resolution 1024 2 1024^{2} analysis (tiled,
bs = = 32), Ours-T requires only 0.045 s (21.8 × \times speedup), satisfying real-time clinical analysis.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed a lightweight nuclei instance segmentation scheme that distills UNI2-h into ConvNeXt-Tiny.
Ours-T retains 98.8% of the teacher’s mPQ with 34.7M parameters (20 × \times compression) and requires only
0.045 s for 1024 2 1024^{2} inference, balancing accuracy and real-time speed. Our experiments further reveal that: (1) MALA is redundant under ViT encoders; (2) output-level distillation suffices for
heterogeneous ViT → \to CNN architectures; and (3) a shared decoder attains equal performance with
37% of the parameters. Limitations include a bPQ still ∼ \sim 2.2% below CFR-SAM-H and the unresolved
extreme imbalance of the Dead class; future work will explore INT8 quantization, TensorRT acceleration, and
alternative teacher models.
blocks.zh:

我们的T保留了教师的mPQ的98.8%,配有34.7M参数(20×\时压缩),只需要
0.045 s for 1024 2 1024^{2}推论,平衡精度和实时速度. 我们的实验还表明:(1) MALA在ViT编码器下是多余的;(2) 输出级蒸馏足以
多样性 VIT =\= 到 CNN 架构;和(3) 一个共享的解码器实现与

死亡阶级的极端不平衡;今后的工作将探索INT8量化,TensorRT加速,以及
